svg.title: Keep IBM i, modernize it, run it where it fits
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Keep it: IBM i integrates the database, middleware, security, runtime and hypervisor, licensed as one. Modernize it: IBM Bob, connected to IBM i, reads and writes source, compiles programs and runs SQL. Run it where it fits: on premises, in an onsite private cloud, or on IBM Power Virtual Server.
